LESSON 30 / 37 • ADDITIONAL CONCEPT
Object-fit and object-position

Object-fit determines how replaced content such as an image fits its box. Object-position aligns
the content inside the box.
Image එකකට width සහ height දුන්නම object-fit: cover එක box එක පුරවනවා, crop Jවන්න
පුළුවන්. contain එක මුළු image එක Jපෙන්වනවා. fill එක stretch කරන්න පුළුවන්. object-position
Consistent square product thumbnails without distortion.

Contain scales to fit and leaves unused area.
Cover thumbnail එක box එක පුරවනවා. Contain එක image එJකේ සම්පූර්ණ හුඩය Jපෙන්වනවා.

img { width: 160px; height: 160px;
  object-fit: cover; object-position: center; }
Expected result: A wide photo fills a square without distortion; some edges are cropped.
Interview question: How does object-fit differ from background-size?

Answer: Object-fit sizes replaced content such as an img; background-size sizes a background
image.
Remember: Object-fit = image content; background-size = background.
Practice: Compare cover, contain and fill on a portrait photo.
